subject: Request: One-off POC credit uplift & extension for MedIQ - exec approval
messages:
From: Anika Patel <anika@mediqhealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-18T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on POC timeline

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team's excited by the latency and the model-level routing ideas. We have a short procurement window before our board meeting on Feb 8.

We started the sandbox this week but hit the PLG cap two days in; the team needs ~3 more weeks of tokens to complete the integration and a short extension so our clinical engineering can finish the eval. Is there any flexibility to provide a one-off credit uplift (around $8k equivalent) and extend the sandbox by 21 days?

Happy to sign a short pilot addendum/PO to formalize it.

Best,
Anika
Director, Product Integrations
MedIQ Health Systems

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>

Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-18T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Quick follow-up on POC timeline — request for uplift/extension

Team — forwarding Anika's note. This is a mid-market prospect (MedIQ) with an integration path into procurement and an upcoming board sign-off (Feb 8). The ask: one-off credit uplift ≈ $8k + 21-day sandbox extension. They are willing to execute a short addendum/PO.

Why I think this is strategic:
- Product fit looks strong; clinical workflows are already instrumented and they plan to push to an initial pilot in Q2.
- Fast procurement timeline (board sign-off) — if we can get them to complete the integration now, we have a strong chance to convert to Dedicated in the next quarter.
- They are asking for a fairly small uplift relative to expected ARR.

Requesting exec signoff + any constraints from Deal Desk/legal. Proposed guardrails: credit applied to project sandbox only, expires 30 days after grant, and addendum to capture terms.

Can we get a thumbs up today? Naomi — can you confirm the existing usage/PLG history and whether this is a unique case? Marissa — what would legal want in the addendum?

Thanks,
Mateo
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-18T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Quick follow-up on POC timeline — request for uplift/extension

Mateo — I pulled their PLG history. They signed up Dec 6, used ~35% of the free credits in the first week, then an engineering spike consumed the remaining credits while testing streaming. Current usage suggests they'll need the uplift to complete the end-to-end test cases.

Customer org: 30 engineers, 6 clinical users in pilot.
ARR signal: Sales forecast model shows $120k ACV likely if pilot succeeds.

I support a one-time $8k uplift with the following conditions:
- Credit restricted to the account sandbox (no refunds or transfers)
- 21-day extension from the grant date
- Signed addendum including standard security and IP language (Marissa to advise)

If Deal Desk signs off, we close the ask quickly.

-naomi
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-18T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Quick follow-up on POC timeline — request for uplift/extension

Thanks — from a legal/deal desk perspective I can draft a one-page pilot addendum. We should include:
- Scope: credit amount ($8,000) applied to sandbox usage only
- Term: 21 day extension + credits expire 30 days after grant
- Liability: standard limited liability clause, no SLA changes
- Data/security: confirmation of SOC2 status and allowed data flows (we've already completed their questionnaire)

I recommend conditioning the uplift on a PO or signed addendum to avoid open credit exposure. Once you confirm PO or sign-off, I'll circulate the doc (I can turn it around same day).

-Marissa
Senior Deal Desk Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-01-18T15:06:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Quick follow-up on POC timeline — request for uplift/extension

All — I approve a one-time credit uplift of $8,000 and a 21-day extension under the guardrails you proposed. Conditions:
1) Credit is sandbox-only and expires 30 days after grant.
2) Customer provides either a signed PO for the addendum or an email confirmation agreeing to the addendum terms before credits are released.
3) Naomi, please move the opportunity to ‘PO Received / Legal Review’ in HubSpot once we have documentation.

Mateo, coordinate with Marissa to get the addendum signed today if possible. This is approved as an exception to PLG limits given the conversion likelihood.

-sean
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference
